text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - USDA said Monday that private exporters reported sales of 100,000 tonnes of soybeans to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year, which began on September 1.

SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp (AFMC) is tendering on July 15 to buy 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybeans. The total comprised 20,000 tonnes for September 20 arrival at the port of Inchon and 20,000 tonnes for arrival by October 20.

SOYMEAL TENDER - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Monday it would invite tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Tuesday. An official at the federation said it would buy the soymeal for arrival by September 30 or October 20 to the ports of Inchon, Kunsan and Ulsan. Shipment for arrival by September 30 was set for August 25-September 13, if sourced from India, or July 28-August 16, if from South America. Shipment for arrival by October 20 was set for September 14-October 3, if from India, or August 17-September 5, if from South America.

MARKET TALK - China authorities have used heat treatment to disinfect part of a shipment of 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans infected with a fungal disease, the official China Daily said. The shipment was imported into China in March.
- Taiwan is expected to tender for up to 54,000 tonnes of corn this week following purchases of 162,000 tonnes in the previous week, traders said on Monday.

- Poor infrastructure at ports and cumbersome customs procedures have been blunting the competitive edge of some of India's exports, Federation of Indian Export Organisations (FIEO) president Ramu Deora said.

VEGETABLE OIL TENDER - Egypt's state Holding Company for Food Industries is tendering on July 16 for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cotton seed, sunflower seed and soya bean oils for delivery in August. The tenders were detailed as follows:

- 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of crude sunflower seed oil and/or semi-refined cotton seed oil and/or American cottonseed oil PBSY 162 for arrival in the first half of August, 1997. - The same amounts and types of oil for arrival in the second half of August.
- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soya bean oil for arrival in the second half of August.
WHEAT TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp (CCC) on July 9 will tender to buy 35,000 tonnes of hard red winter for donation to Tajikistan. Shipment was scheduled for July 23 to August 7.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.
MARKET TALK (cont.) - Japanese and South Korean importers are expected to pick up several more cargoes of corn and wheat this week to cover their needs for the last third of the year, dealers said.

- USDA reported U.S. soybean export inspections for the week to July 3 totalled 3.11 million bushels, down from 6.61 million a week earlier, wheat inspections rose to 14.03 million from 11.06 million and corn inspections fell to 20.29 million from 29.54 million.
